nta_gtfs_all.coverage: Published NTA all-operator feed; not a guarantee of complete island-wide coverage.
nta_gtfs_all.refresh_policy: Refresh before pairing with live updates; NTA says static IDs may change and updates may occur daily. HTTP freshness is not service-calendar validity.

nta_gtfs_realtime.coverage: Static timetable subset for NTA realtime operators, not realtime observations.
nta_gtfs_realtime.refresh_policy: Refresh before pairing with live updates; NTA says static IDs may change and updates may occur daily. HTTP freshness is not service-calendar validity.

nta_gtfs_luas.coverage: Luas network only; small live-source validation feed.
nta_gtfs_luas.refresh_policy: Refresh before pairing with live updates; NTA says static IDs may change and updates may occur daily. HTTP freshness is not service-calendar validity.
